verdict.rationale: Aider is a local CLI that operates directly on the user's own files and git repository, committing all changes as standard git commits (open format) that the user fully owns and can inspect or remove with raw git commands, so there's no vendor lock-in in the traditional SaaS sense. However, there is no explicit documentation of a formal 'export my data' feature, chat history export, or data-portability statement in the evidence pack. Missing for 10: explicit export/data-portability documentation, confirmation of open format for chat/session history, and any statement addressing account/data deletion or migration.
